Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.views.markdown

Class CommonmarkMarkdownRenderer

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.views.markdown.CommonmarkMarkdownRenderer
All Implemented Interfaces:
MarkdownRenderer
public class CommonmarkMarkdownRenderer extends Object implements MarkdownRenderer
The default MarkdownRenderer implementation: a thin wrapper around commonmark-java with the GFM tables extension enabled, HTML-escaped raw markup, and URL allowlisting on <a href> / <img src>.

The GFM tables extension is on by default because real-world documents (runbooks, onboarding guides, skills) routinely use pipe tables, and core CommonMark renders them as paragraphs of literal pipes.

Raw HTML in the markdown source is escaped (escapeHtml(true)), so a <script> or <img onerror> in a SKILL.md becomes visible text, not an element. Link and image URLs are restricted to http/https/mailto, fragments, and scheme-less relative paths; javascript:, data:, and vbscript: are stripped.

commonmark-java's Parser and HtmlRenderer are immutable and thread-safe once built, so a single instance of this class is safe to share across threads and reuse for every render.
